## Goal
- Build and deploy IVX IA as a **fully owner-controlled AI engineering platform** that can operate, code, test, commit, deploy, monitor, and recover WITHOUT Rork — execute end-to-end, not return only a plan; remove all Rork dependencies from the normal development path; verify and sync all credentials live; **rebuild IVX Owner AI as a REAL senior developer that never reports false completion**

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_FACTORY_MODE, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION
- No fake data, no placeholder progress — honest about what can/cannot be done from inside Rork sandbox
- Owner demands honest senior-developer audit — NOT narrative claims; wants real end-to-end proof
- Owner demands Senior Developer answer format: structured TASK ID / STATUS / FILES CHANGED / COMMANDS / TESTS / DEPLOYED proof — NOT product-support summaries
- **Owner's 17-PHASE ENTERPRISE AUTH RECOVERY MANDATE (2026-07-21)**: critical security incident — owner password exposed in screenshot; full enterprise auth overhaul: freeze, audit Supabase project, audit owner user, reset password, revoke sessions, 12-char password policy, trace IDs, remove auth conflicts, session management, auth vs authorization separation, rate limiting, optional MFA (OFF by default), email delivery, member self-service, DB/RLS QA, 40 automated tests, physical-device QA, structured production proof
- **Owner's CERTIFICATION FIX MANDATE (completed 2026-07-20)**: closed both routing gaps — code-change routing + QA-only handler
- **SIGN-IN AUTH MANDATE (completed 2026-07-20)**: password reset; sign-in verified 10/10 live with backend probes
- **CRITICAL**: DEPLOYED ≠ VERIFIED; a CODE_FIX/UI_FIX/FEATURE task with no code change is NOT complete
- **CRITICAL SECURITY**: never display/log/store passwords in screenshots, logs, analytics, alerts, proof reports; redact as ********; never hardcode passwords; never bypass Supabase auth
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — use `node:zlib` `gzipSync`; `.toString('base64')`; repo-root relative paths; for large files write payload to `/tmp/*.json` and use `--data-binary @file`
- Render deploy API: same endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at` (raw JWT, EXPIRED/revoked) or `/tmp/owner_at.json` (JSON with `accessToken` field, re-minted 2026-07-21, 1620 chars, working); re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`; token expires ~1h
- APK presign upload API: `POST /api/ivx/apk/presign-upload` with `{key, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD"}` — returns `uploadUrl` (S3 presigned PUT) + `publicUrl`; then `curl -X PUT` the APK to `uploadUrl`
- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)
- Owner-AI POST requires `{"message": "..."}` field (NOT `"prompt"`)
- Worker job status endpoint returns nested `job` key: `d.get('job')` NOT top-level; result at `job.get('result')`
- Per-owner single-flight: only one active task per owner at a time
- `bun test backend/` = 1709 pass / 0 fail (6230 expects)
- Bash commands must complete under 60s or timeout; Render propagation ~2-4 min; Gradle build takes ~1-3 min (run via nohup background + poll)
- Clean sandbox has NO `node_modules` — must run `bun install` before tests or tsc
- `watchman` disabled (moved to `/usr/local/bin/watchman.disabled`) to prevent Metro issues
- MFA must be optional, OFF by default; user enables in Settings → Security → Two-Factor Authentication; never auto-enroll
